before_source: p1-headline-before-20261106-05; first unprofiled pair only, three-pair run and receivers pending

hypothesis.work: Remove unused outer-role columns from the composition LDE and evaluate each rl+2 role as two sequential rl+1 cosets, retaining original denominator slices and RLC powers. Existing numerical kernels only.
hypothesis.time_removed: Target 1.7-2.2 s from the measured 6.123 s fullstack recursion window, primarily by making sibling nodes fit, with smaller FFT traffic secondary. This is an estimate, not a performance claim.
hypothesis.success_bar: At least a positive matched whole-request change versus the default. The first fullstack pair is 0.9402 s slower than default; saving less than that does not establish a win. Exact node peak <=11e9 bytes remains a separate P1 gate.
hypothesis.no_claim: The 70 ms composition FFT spans on large small-block nodes cannot alone explain a multi-second latency improvement; the intended mechanism is less admission waiting and actual simultaneous work.

candidate_boundary.flag: STWO_RV64_RC_COMPOSITION_COSETS=1; default off; current local implementation only
candidate_boundary.eligible: outer composition only; eval_log=trace_log+2; auxiliary none; resident compact columns of trace_log; enqueue mode; no shared role workspace; original path for ineligible roles
candidate_boundary.mapping: Deduplicate (tree,column) from authenticated KernelMetadata.program.inputs; pack only referenced columns. Point all three packet tree bases at one compact evaluation slab and remap each mask offset to its packed slot. Validate every borrowed source range in the proof scope.
candidate_boundary.cosets: Tile size N/2. Drop the first all-zero-high-half FFT stage. Repack each remaining twiddle layer from the global tower selecting the corresponding half; preserve the final circle layer. All source coefficient counts <=N/4. Use existing n2b_columns at eval_log-1.
candidate_boundary.rows: For el=rl+2, a trace-row shift preserves each N/2 tile; global_mask(tile*N/2+row)-tile*N/2 equals local_mask(row,rl,el-1). Dispatch unchanged AOT with tile eval_log, original powers, and original global denominator slice.
candidate_boundary.bucket: Use a bounded eight-plane tile output; copy corresponding coordinate slices of the original bucket in, accumulate the role, copy them back. Original global bucket/finalization/proof geometry remain unchanged.
candidate_boundary.cost: Update both source-class preflight and actual-role workspace planning to charge exactly the selected column slab, tile output, twiddle slice, descriptors/logs and retained metadata. Do not shrink only the runtime allocations while leaving false admission futures.
candidate_boundary.timing: FFT/row work interleaves across tiles, so any combined per-role event span must be labelled as combined; CUPTI complete activity remains authoritative.

validation.cpu_screen: Deterministic full-versus-half packed FFT equality at logs5..10 and 14112 shifted-row cases passed in exploratory Python; requires reproducible implementation tests.
validation.gpu: Small block smoke, byte identity and fresh receivers; then canonical composed 3+3 on headline. No further memory feature before measuring this candidate.
validation.gate: Full rv64_gate.sh before commit, including new quiet-admission tests. Record negative timing rather than promote an unhelpful flag.

before_failure.note: First fullstack service completed cold+warm; second failed warm. Completed-service CPU receivers were launched separately after timing stopped.
